name: ArrayMax
description: Find the maximum value across an array of signals (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Outputs both the maximum value and the index of the channel where it was found. Sample-accurate.

inputs.name: array
inputs.description: Array of input signals to scan

name: ArrayMin
description: Find the minimum value across an array of signals (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Outputs both the minimum value and the index of the channel where it was found. Sample-accurate.

inputs.name: array
inputs.description: Array of input signals to scan

name: BufMax
description: Find the maximum sample value in a buffer (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Outputs both the maximum value and the frame index where it occurs. The scan happens whenever the gate goes from <=0 to >0.

inputs.name: gate
inputs.description: Re-trigger the scan on positive gate transitions

name: BufMin
description: Find the minimum sample value in a buffer (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Outputs both the minimum value and the frame index where it occurs. The scan happens whenever the gate goes from <=0 to >0.

inputs.name: gate
inputs.description: Re-trigger the scan on positive gate transitions

name: Cepstrum
description: Real cepstrum: PV chain that computes the cepstrum of an FFT chain and stores it in a buffer (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). The cepstrum is the inverse FFT of the log magnitude spectrum, useful for pitch tracking and source/filter separation.

inputs.name: cepbuf
inputs.description: Buffer to store the cepstrum frames

name: ICepstrum
description: Inverse cepstrum: PV chain that converts a cepstrum buffer back to an FFT chain (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Used to undo the Cepstrum transform after spectral envelope manipulation.

inputs.name: fftbuf
inputs.description: FFT buffer to write the resynthesised spectrum into

name: PV_DiffMags
description: DEPRECATED — renamed to PV_MagSubtract. Subtracts the magnitudes of FFT chain B from chain A (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens).

name: PV_MagSubtract
description: Subtract the magnitudes of FFT chain B from chain A bin-by-bin (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Optionally clip negative results to zero. Useful for spectral subtraction noise reduction.

inputs.name: bufferA
inputs.description: First FFT chain (minuend) — output uses these phases

inputs.name: zerolimit
inputs.description: If non-zero, clip negative magnitudes to zero

name: PV_MagLog
description: Take the natural logarithm of the magnitudes of an FFT chain (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Phases are preserved. Often used as a step in cepstrum-style processing.

name: PV_MagExp
description: Apply the exponential function to the magnitudes of an FFT chain (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Phases are preserved. The inverse of PV_MagLog.

name: PV_Whiten
description: Spectral whitening of an FFT chain (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Tracks per-bin peak magnitudes in a tracking buffer and divides each bin by its tracked peak, flattening the spectrum. Useful as preprocessing for onset detection.

inputs.name: trackbufnum
inputs.description: Buffer for tracking per-bin peak magnitudes (must be allocated externally)

inputs.name: relaxtime
inputs.description: Time in seconds for tracked peaks to decay halfway

inputs.name: floor
inputs.description: Lower limit for the tracked magnitude — avoids division by zero / amplification of noise

inputs.name: smear
inputs.description: Number of adjacent bins to smear peaks across

inputs.name: bindownsample
inputs.description: Number of bins to downsample for peak tracking (0 = no downsampling)

name: PV_MagSmooth
description: Per-bin magnitude smoothing across consecutive FFT frames (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Acts as a one-pole low-pass filter applied independently to each bin's magnitude sequence.

inputs.name: factor
inputs.description: Smoothing factor (0 = no smoothing, near 1 = heavy smoothing)

name: PV_MagMulAdd
description: Apply a linear transform to FFT magnitudes: new_mag = mag * mul + add (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Phases are preserved. Useful for gain staging and DC offsets in the spectral domain.

inputs.name: add
inputs.description: Constant added to each magnitude after multiplication

name: PV_ExtractRepeat
description: Extract or remove a repeating spectral pattern from an FFT chain (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Holds a memory buffer of recent magnitude history and flags bins that match (or differ from) a learned loop. Useful for source separation and de-looping.

inputs.name: loopbuf
inputs.description: Buffer that stores the learned loop spectrum

inputs.name: loopdur
inputs.description: Duration of the loop in seconds

inputs.name: memorytime
inputs.description: How many seconds of memory to use when learning the loop

inputs.name: which
inputs.description: 0 = output the repeating part, non-zero = output the residual

inputs.name: ffthop
inputs.description: FFT hop fraction (must match the producing FFT)

inputs.name: thresh
inputs.description: Threshold for deciding whether a bin is part of the repeat

name: FFTPower
description: Total power (sum of squared magnitudes) of an FFT chain (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Outputs once per FFT frame and holds the value between frames.

inputs.name: square
inputs.description: If 1, sum squared magnitudes (true power); if 0, sum magnitudes

name: FFTDiffMags
description: Sum of absolute differences between magnitudes of two FFT chains (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). A simple spectral-distance feature, useful for change detection.

name: FFTFlux
description: Spectral flux of an FFT chain (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Sum of squared bin-by-bin magnitude differences between successive frames; classic onset-detection feature.

inputs.name: normalise
inputs.description: If non-zero, normalise the differences by total frame energy

name: FFTFluxPos
description: Positive-only spectral flux (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Like FFTFlux but only sums bins whose magnitude increased — biases detection toward note onsets rather than offsets.

inputs.name: normalise
inputs.description: If non-zero, normalise the differences by total frame energy

name: FFTSubbandPower
description: Power within each of N user-defined frequency subbands of an FFT chain (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Cutfreqs is a sorted list of band edges; output is one channel per subband (numbands+1 outputs in SuperCollider). Vibelang exposes the first output channel.

inputs.name: cutfreqs
inputs.description: Sorted array of band edge frequencies in Hz

inputs.name: square
inputs.description: If 1, sum squared magnitudes (power); if 0, sum magnitudes

inputs.name: scalemode
inputs.description: Scaling mode for output (1 = normalised by bin count)

name: FFTSubbandFlux
description: Spectral flux computed independently within N user-defined frequency subbands (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). One output channel per subband (numbands+1 in SuperCollider). Vibelang exposes the first output channel.

inputs.name: cutfreqs
inputs.description: Sorted array of band edge frequencies in Hz

inputs.name: posonly
inputs.description: If non-zero, sum only positive bin-magnitude changes

name: FFTPhaseDev
description: Phase deviation onset-detection feature for an FFT chain (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Sums the deviations between observed phases and phases predicted from the previous two frames — peaks on transients.

inputs.name: weight
inputs.description: If non-zero, weight each bin's deviation by its magnitude

inputs.name: powthresh
inputs.description: Power threshold below which a bin is ignored

name: FFTComplexDev
description: Complex-domain onset-detection feature (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Distance between observed complex bins and bins predicted from the previous two frames; can be rectified to keep only positive (onset-like) changes.

inputs.name: rectify
inputs.description: If non-zero, only count bins whose magnitude grew

inputs.name: powthresh
inputs.description: Power threshold below which a bin is ignored

name: FFTMKL
description: Modified Kullback-Leibler divergence between successive FFT frames (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). An onset-detection feature emphasising spectral novelty rather than energy change.

inputs.name: epsilon
inputs.description: Small constant added inside the log to avoid log(0)

name: FFTCentroid
description: DEPRECATED — use SpecCentroid instead. Spectral centroid of an FFT chain (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens).

name: FFTSubbandFlatness
description: Spectral flatness measured independently within N user-defined frequency subbands (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Each subband flatness is geometric-mean / arithmetic-mean of magnitudes. One channel per subband (numbands+1); vibelang exposes the first.

inputs.name: cutfreqs
inputs.description: Sorted array of band edge frequencies in Hz

name: FFTCrest
description: Spectral crest factor over a frequency range (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Ratio of the maximum magnitude to the mean magnitude — high for tonal signals, low for noisy signals.

name: FFTSpread
description: Spectral spread (second moment) of an FFT chain (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Variance of bin frequencies weighted by magnitude, around the supplied centroid.

inputs.name: centroid
inputs.description: Spectral centroid (typically from SpecCentroid.kr) — required for the calculation

name: FFTSlope
description: Spectral slope of an FFT chain (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Linear-regression slope of magnitudes versus bin frequency — negative for typical natural sounds, near zero for noise.

name: FFTPeak
description: Strongest frequency peak in an FFT chain over a given frequency range (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Outputs the peak frequency in Hz and its magnitude.

name: RosslerL
description: Rössler chaotic attractor with linear interpolation (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Three-dimensional continuous-time chaos: x' = -y - z; y' = x + a*y; z' = b + z*(x - c). Outputs x, y, z as a three-channel signal.

name: RosslerResL
description: Rössler attractor driven by an external excitation, with a stiff coupling (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Same equations as RosslerL but the input signal perturbs the trajectory. Three-channel output.

inputs.name: stiff
inputs.description: Stiffness — how strongly the input perturbs the system

name: FincoSprottL
description: Finco-Sprott 'L' chaotic attractor with linear interpolation (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). x' = y + z; y' = a*|x| - y; z' = 1 - x. Three-channel x, y, z output.

name: FincoSprottM
description: Finco-Sprott 'M' chaotic attractor (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Three-channel x, y, z output. Note that parameter a is negative compared to the published version.

name: FincoSprottS
description: Finco-Sprott 'S' chaotic attractor (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Three-channel x, y, z output.

name: RMAFoodChainL
description: Rosenzweig-MacArthur three-species food chain attractor (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Continuous-time predator-prey chaos with 12 parameters. Three-channel x, y, z output.

name: Perlin3
description: 3D Perlin noise (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Smooth, gradient-based noise sampled at the supplied (x, y, z) coordinate. Useful as a smoothly-varying random control signal.

name: InsideOut
description: Distortion that 'flips' the signal envelope inside out: samples close to zero become the loudest, and peaks become quietest (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Aggressive nonlinear distortion.

name: WaveLoss
description: Drop a configurable proportion of waveform segments between zero crossings (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Sounds like a glitchy bit-loss artefact. Drop is the count to drop, outof is the period.

inputs.name: drop
inputs.description: Number of zero-crossing segments to drop per group

inputs.name: outof
inputs.description: Group size — drop is taken out of every 'outof' segments

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: 1 = pseudo-random selection within each group, 2 = first-N pattern

name: Squiz
description: Pitch-raising distortion by repeating short waveform chunks at a higher rate (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Roughly transposes upward without standard pitch-shifting artefacts; sounds gritty and lo-fi.

inputs.name: zcperchunk
inputs.description: Number of zero crossings per repeated chunk

name: Logger
description: Log an array of input values into a buffer on each trigger (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Useful for capturing analysis features over time. Buffer must have one channel per input.

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger — write a frame on each positive transition

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Reset the write head to frame 0 on positive transitions

inputs.name: inputArray
inputs.description: Array of values to log on each trigger

name: ListTrig
description: Trigger from a list of frame indices stored in a buffer (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Fires whenever the running sample index reaches the next entry. Useful for replaying detected onset times.

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer holding sorted trigger frame indices

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Reset the read head on positive transitions

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: Index offset added to each buffer entry

inputs.name: numframes
inputs.description: Total number of frames being scrubbed (defaults to BufFrames)

name: ListTrig2
description: Trigger from a list of inter-onset intervals stored in a buffer (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Like ListTrig but each entry is a delta time rather than an absolute frame index.

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Reset the read head on positive transitions

inputs.name: numframes
inputs.description: Total number of frames being scrubbed (defaults to BufFrames)

name: GaussClass
description: Gaussian-classifier on an input feature vector (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Reads a buffer of Gaussian classes (mean, inverse-covariance, weight) and outputs the index of the most likely class for the input vector.

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer of class parameters (use GaussClass.classesToFloatArray to prepare)

name: MIDelay
description: Mutual-information-based delay estimator between two signals (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Reports the lag at which mutual information between the two streams is maximised. Originally Dan Stowell — currently disabled in upstream sc3-plugins.

inputs.name: mibuf
inputs.description: Optional buffer to write per-lag MI estimates into (-1 = none)

name: Friction
description: Stick-slip friction filter (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Models a mass on a moving belt with friction, spring and damping — produces squeaks and bowed-string textures from arbitrary inputs.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input signal that drives the belt motion

inputs.name: friction
inputs.description: Friction coefficient between mass and belt

inputs.name: spring
inputs.description: Spring constant connecting the mass to the rest position

inputs.name: damp
inputs.description: Damping coefficient for the mass motion

inputs.name: beltmass
inputs.description: Mass of the belt (effective inertia of the input)

name: Crest
description: Time-domain crest factor over a sliding window (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Ratio of peak absolute value to RMS over numsamps samples — high for percussive signals, low for sustained ones.

name: Goertzel
description: Goertzel single-bin DFT (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Efficient detector of energy at one specific frequency without doing a full FFT. Outputs the real and imaginary components of the bin.

inputs.name: hop
inputs.description: Hop size as a fraction of bufsize

name: SawDPW
description: Sawtooth oscillator using the Differentiated Parabolic Wave (DPW) method (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Cheaper than a band-limited oscillator and noticeably better than a naive saw — has slight amplitude droop at very low frequencies.

name: PulseDPW
description: Pulse-wave oscillator built from two SawDPW oscillators (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Cheaper than a band-limited Pulse with similar audible quality. Width controls the duty cycle.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Pulse width as a fraction (0 to 1)

name: Getenv
description: Read an environment variable from the SuperCollider server's process at synth instantiation time (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Scalar (init-rate) — value is fixed once the synth starts.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: Environment variable name (encoded as ASCII byte sequence in upstream SC)

inputs.name: defaultval
inputs.description: Value to use if the variable is not set or not numeric

name: Clockmus
description: Microsecond clock reading from the host system (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Useful for timing measurements inside a synthdef — e.g. to measure how long an audio block takes to compute.

name: TextVU
description: Print a text VU meter to stdout for diagnostic monitoring (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Pass-through — outputs the input unchanged. Width controls the bar character count.

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger / refresh rate. If a float, treated as Hz; otherwise as a trigger signal

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Label string (encoded as ASCII byte sequence in upstream SC)

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Reset the peak indicator on positive transitions

inputs.name: ana
inputs.description: Analyser signal — pre-computed amplitude (defaults to Amplitude.kr internally)

name: MeanTriggered
description: Running mean of the input over the last N triggered samples (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Whenever trig fires, the current input is added to a circular buffer of length 'length' and the buffer's mean is output.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input signal sampled on each trigger

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger — sample on each positive transition

inputs.name: length
inputs.description: Number of past samples kept in the running window

name: MedianTriggered
description: Running median of the input over the last N triggered samples (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Like MeanTriggered but outputs the median — robust against outliers, useful for trimming spurious onset-detection peaks.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input signal sampled on each trigger

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger — sample on each positive transition

inputs.name: length
inputs.description: Number of past samples kept in the running window

name: KMeansRT
description: Real-time K-means clustering on incoming feature vectors (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Reads/writes centroids in a buffer, outputs the cluster index of the current input. Optionally keeps learning while running.

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer holding the K centroids (rows = K, channels = ndims+1)

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Reset learned centroids on positive transitions

inputs.name: learn
inputs.description: If non-zero, update centroids online; otherwise only classify

name: OnsetsDS
description: Pseudo-UGen wrapping a complete onset-detection setup (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens): FFT, whitening, an onset-detection function, median filter, threshold and minimum-gap. DEPRECATED — Dan Stowell recommends Onsets.kr instead.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input audio signal (or pre-computed FFT chain if extchain is true)

inputs.name: extchain
inputs.description: If non-zero, treat 'in' as an existing FFT chain rather than audio

inputs.name: mingap
inputs.description: Minimum gap between detected onsets, in seconds

inputs.name: medianspan
inputs.description: Number of frames in the median filter

name: PlaneTree
description: Server-side hyperplane decision-tree classifier (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Reads a tree from a buffer (built language-side, e.g. via the KDTree quark) and emits the leaf path-integer for each input feature vector.

inputs.name: treebuf
inputs.description: Buffer containing the tree node data

name: NearestN
description: Server-side nearest-neighbour search in a kd-tree (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Returns 'num' nearest matches as [index, distSquared] pairs followed by a free slot, in 3*num output channels. Vibelang exposes the first output channel.

inputs.name: treebuf
inputs.description: Buffer containing kd-tree node data (use NearestN.makeBufferData to prepare)

inputs.name: num
inputs.description: Number of nearest neighbours to find

name: MatchingP
description: Matching-pursuit decomposition over a dictionary buffer (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Iteratively finds the best-matching atoms in the dictionary for the input signal and outputs the chosen indices and activation amplitudes.

inputs.name: dict
inputs.description: Dictionary buffer (rows = atoms, columns = atom samples)

inputs.name: dictsize
inputs.description: Number of atoms in the dictionary

inputs.name: ntofind
inputs.description: Number of atoms to keep per analysis frame

inputs.name: hop
inputs.description: Hop size as a fraction of the atom length

name: MatchingPResynth
description: Resynthesise a signal from matching-pursuit activations (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Pairs with MatchingP — given the dictionary and a list of [index, amplitude] activations it sums the chosen atoms back into a waveform.

inputs.name: dict
inputs.description: Dictionary buffer (must match the one used by MatchingP)

inputs.name: method
inputs.description: Resynthesis method (0 = sum of selected atoms)

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: Trigger — start a new resynthesis frame on positive transitions

inputs.name: residual
inputs.description: Optional residual signal to add to the resynthesis

inputs.name: activs
inputs.description: Array of activations as [idx0, amp0, idx1, amp1, ...]

name: SOMTrain
description: Train a Self-Organising Map on streaming input data (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Updates the supplied buffer in place. Outputs three values: best-match coordinate, current learning rate, current neighbourhood radius (vibelang exposes the first).

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer holding the SOM weights (allocate via SOMTrain.allocBuf)

inputs.name: netsize
inputs.description: Number of nodes per dimension of the SOM grid

inputs.name: numdims
inputs.description: Number of dimensions of the SOM grid (1-4)

inputs.name: traindur
inputs.description: Total training duration in control-rate frames

inputs.name: nhood
inputs.description: Initial neighbourhood radius (fraction of grid size)

name: SOMRd
description: Read the best-matching node from a trained Self-Organising Map (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Outputs the integer coordinates of the BMU on the SOM grid (numdims channels). Vibelang exposes the first output channel.

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer holding the trained SOM weights

inputs.name: netsize
inputs.description: Number of nodes per dimension of the SOM grid

inputs.name: numdims
inputs.description: Number of dimensions of the SOM grid (1-4)

inputs.name: inputdata
inputs.description: Input feature vector to look up

name: SOMAreaWr
description: Write a feature vector into a region of a Self-Organising Map around supplied coordinates (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Lets you train a SOM by direct supervised insertion rather than competitive learning.

inputs.name: netsize
inputs.description: Number of nodes per dimension of the SOM grid

inputs.name: numdims
inputs.description: Number of dimensions of the SOM grid (1-4)

inputs.name: inputdata
inputs.description: Input feature vector to write, followed by target coordinates

name: CQ_Diff
description: Constant-Q magnitude-difference UGen, based on Qitch (sc3-plugins MCLDUGens). Compares two constant-Q analyses against a reference data buffer for pitch/spectrum matching.
